title: Gate G: the long-horizon campaign's counters see what they count
note: D-2026-181. Each blinds a counter the campaign reports apart: a second execution, a second receipt, a restart, or a retry miscounted as a duplicate. tests/test_research_horizon.py holds the counters to each other over a short stage with a crash in it, and the duplicate counter to a positive control.

mutations.name: RH1_a_second_execution_is_not_counted
mutations.rationale: G: a task executed twice over the horizon reads as executed once

mutations.name: RH2_a_second_receipt_is_not_counted
mutations.rationale: G: a proposal received twice reads as received once

mutations.name: RH3_a_retry_is_a_duplicate
mutations.rationale: G: the attempts a retry is allowed are counted as duplicate answers

mutations.name: RH4_a_restart_is_not_counted
mutations.rationale: G: a resumption after a crash is not counted, so restarts and resets merge
